purpose: W9-A: build platform treasury as a separate accounting/read projection over canonical FinancialObligation, settlement receipts and bank facts, adding bank-account registry, platform receivable/payable, revenue recognition, partner accrual, payment authority matrix and 13-week cash forecast without creating another wallet/ledger.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue PC-CROP. Staged only; no implementation authority before separate governance review/merge and immutable base-state promotion.
requiredInvariants: Treasury is a projection/accounting control over canonical obligations and settlement/bank receipts; it never becomes another payment wallet, Deal balance or ledger mutation authority.

BankAccountRegistry stores platform/organization-owned settlement account references, purpose, currency, legal owner, provider/bank binding, validity and authority metadata without storing online-banking credentials in business rows.

PlatformReceivable/Payable entries are derived from exact accepted FinancialObligation and rule/contract bases; manual treasury rows require an explicit separately authorized accounting basis and cannot invent Deal/provider debts.

Revenue recognition is versioned by policy and source event/basis. Cash receipt and accounting revenue are separate facts; receipt alone cannot silently recognize revenue when performance conditions are unmet.
Partner accrual is derived from accepted service/partner obligations and immutable completion/acceptance evidence. Provider selection alone does not accrue a payable.

PaymentAuthorityMatrix is versioned and specifies roles/job profiles, amount thresholds, dual approval, allowed bank-account purpose and action types. It cannot broaden existing settlement/signature/accounting authority.

13-week forecast is a projection over dated obligations, expected receipts/payments and scenario assumptions. Forecast assumptions are versioned and visibly distinct from confirmed cash/obligation facts.
All money uses exact minor units/currency. No Float, spreadsheet/manual total or environment default becomes authoritative treasury fact.
Historical treasury snapshots/revenue/accrual decisions are immutable/versioned and preserve exact source obligation/receipt/policy revisions.
Current actor/organization/staff authority is server-validated; organization users cannot inspect platform-wide treasury unless explicitly entitled and cross-tenant access is denied.
Mutation/policy publication commits immutable event, audit and outbox atomically with idempotency/CAS; a failed evidence write cannot leave an accepted treasury decision.
Federal Accounting lock #4321 is read-only. Any later accounting-document consumer change requires separately authorized lock-scoped work.
Registration, Role Eligibility, Settlement ledger, bank adapters, packages/lockfiles and REG.RU production topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Restricted PostgreSQL tests prove bank-account registry, exact receivable/payable projections, revenue recognition and partner accrual are pinned to canonical source ids/revisions.
Receipt timing vs revenue timing cases prove cash receipt cannot automatically recognize revenue and accrued payable cannot exist without accepted basis evidence.
PaymentAuthorityMatrix tests cover threshold/dual-approval/role/job-profile restrictions without widening existing financial command authority.
13-week forecast reproduces from persisted assumptions and source obligation revisions and labels forecast vs confirmed facts distinctly.
Cross-tenant and unauthorized organization/staff access, stale policy, changed-payload replay and revoked authority fail closed.
Audit/outbox/event failure rolls back policy/treasury decision state.
No treasury command creates/changes a settlement payment, bank operation or Federal Accounting record in foundation tests.
Exact-head CI/review plus later REG.RU treasury/finance-user acceptance are required before terminal treasury credit.
remainingTerminalBoundary: W5-A canonical obligations/SettlementPlan must be accepted and consumer-wired before treasury can be terminally complete.
Real bank account/provider balances require separately governed bank integrations/receipts if displayed.
Accounting reports/documents that consume treasury need Federal Accounting lock #4321 authorization.
REG.RU production and finance/operator unaided acceptance remain mandatory.
